author: Dengzi555
body:
🤖

#### References to other Issues or PRs

No issue was filed. The defect was found while checking that the output of `srepr` can be parsed back.

#### Brief description of what is fixed or changed

`Dummy.__new__` stored `dummy_index` as given. `srepr` writes it as a bare integer, but `parse_expr`/`sympify` runs `auto_number`, which turns that integer into a SymPy `Integer`. `Basic.__eq__` compares hashable content items strictly by number type, so the recreated `Dummy` was not equal to the original one:

```python
>>> d = Dummy('d', dummy_index=5)
>>> sympify(srepr(d + 1)) == d + 1
False
>>> sympify(srepr(CRootOf(x**3 - x + 1, 0)))
PolynomialError: only univariate polynomials are allowed
```

In the second case the two occurrences of the same `Dummy` inside the polynomial become two separate generators.

The change normalizes `dummy_index` to `int` in `Dummy.__new__`, so the stored value does not depend on whether it arrives as a Python integer or as a SymPy `Integer`.

#### Other comments

One line in `sympy/core/symbol.py`. The tests cover the equality in both directions, the `Dummy` round-trip and the `CRootOf` round-trip that exposed the problem; all three fail without the change.

`sympy/core/tests` and `sympy/polys/tests`: 2969 passed, 81 skipped, 29 xfailed. `ruff check` on the four touched files passes.

The second commit adds the author line to `.mailmap`, which `bin/mailmap_check.py` asks for in the Check Authors job.

#### AI Generation Disclosure

The change, the tests and this text were generated by an AI coding agent (Claude, via WorkBuddy). The account owner reproduced the failure and reviewed the diff before submission. AI-generated parts: `sympy/core/symbol.py` line 518; `sympy/core/tests/test_symbol.py` lines 53-56; `sympy/core/tests/test_sympify.py` line 9 and lines 49-51; `sympy/polys/tests/test_rootoftools.py` lines 29-30 and 35-36; the `.mailmap` line added in the second commit.

#### Release Notes

<!-- BEGIN RELEASE NOTES -->
* core
  * Fixed `Dummy` equality when `dummy_index` is a SymPy `Integer`, so that `sympify(srepr(expr))` keeps `Dummy` symbols intact.
<!-- END RELEASE NOTES -->

commits.author: dengzi
commits.message:
Normalize Dummy dummy_index to int

`srepr` writes the dummy index as a bare integer, but `parse_expr` runs
`auto_number` and turns it into a SymPy `Integer`. Since `Basic.__eq__`
compares hashable content items strictly by number type, the recreated
`Dummy` was not equal to the original one, and any expression containing
it changed shape after a `sympify(srepr(...))` round-trip.

Store the index as an int so it does not depend on how it was passed.

commits.author: dengzi
commits.message:
Add the commit author to .mailmap

The Check Authors job runs bin/mailmap_check.py, which requires every
author in the git history to have an entry in .mailmap.

@@ -50,6 +50,10 @@ def test_Dummy():

     raises(AssertionError, lambda: Dummy(dummy_index=1))
     assert Dummy('d', dummy_index=2) == Dummy('d', dummy_index=2)
+    d_int = Dummy('d', dummy_index=2)
+    d_sympified = Dummy('d', dummy_index=sympify(2))
+    assert d_int == d_sympified

     d1 = Dummy('d', dummy_index=3)
     d2 = Dummy('d')
